history.content: Hi, my phone has no signal at all. Nothing loads, I can't send picture messages, and I can't get online or make a call. Can you help?

I can help you with this issue. To get started, I need to identify your account. Could you please provide one of the following:

- The phone number associated with your account
- Your customer ID
- Your full name and date of birth

Once I have this information, I can begin troubleshooting your service problem.
My name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Thank you for providing your information. Your line is currently active, so let's begin troubleshooting your service issue.

To help you further, could you please check your phone's status bar and let me know if you see any of the following:

- Airplane mode icon (✈️)
- "No Signal" or a signal strength indicator (bars)
- Any network type indicator (e.g., 5G, 4G, LTE)

This will help determine if the issue is related to your phone's settings or the network. If you need instructions on how to check, let me know your phone model or operating system (Android/iPhone).
I see the Airplane Mode icon and it says No Signal in the status bar. Data is enabled too.

The Airplane Mode icon means all wireless connections—including cellular service—are turned off, which is why you have no signal and nothing is loading.

Please turn off Airplane Mode on your phone. You can usually do this by:

- Swiping down from the top of your screen (Android) or up from the bottom/right corner (iPhone) to open the quick settings/control center.
- Tapping the airplane icon so it is no longer highlighted.

Once Airplane Mode is off, check if your signal returns and if you can make calls or use data. Let me know what you see after turning it off.
Airplane mode is now off, but I still don't have any signal bars and it still says No Signal. Nothing is loading yet.

Thank you for turning off Airplane Mode. Since you still have no signal, the next step is to check your SIM card status, as issues with the SIM card can cause a complete loss of service.

Could you please check your SIM card status on your phone? If you need instructions, let me know your phone model or operating system (Android/iPhone). 

Once you check, let me know if your phone says the SIM is:
- Active/Ready
- Missing/Not detected
- Locked (PIN or PUK required)

This will help determine the next step to restore your service.
I'm not sure what my SIM status is. I'm using an Android phone—can you tell me how to check?

Certainly! Here’s how you can check your SIM card status on most Android phones:

1. Open the Settings app.
2. Tap on Connections or Network & Internet (the exact name may vary).
3. Tap on SIM card manager or SIM cards.
4. Look for SIM status or SIM information.

You should see information about your SIM card, such as whether it’s active, missing, or locked.

Please let me know what it says about your SIM card status. If you see any error messages or warnings, please mention those as well.
I checked the SIM status and it says 'No SIM card detected.'

Thank you for checking. The message "No SIM card detected" means your phone is not recognizing the SIM card, which is why you have no signal.

Please try the following steps:
1. Power off your phone.
2. Remove the SIM card tray and take out the SIM card.
3. Carefully reinsert the SIM card, making sure it is properly seated.
4. Put the tray back in and power your phone back on.

After your phone restarts, check if the SIM card is detected and if you have signal bars. Let me know if this resolves the issue or if it still says "No SIM card detected."
After reseating the SIM card, my phone says the SIM is still Locked. I still have no signal.
YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.

arguments.summary: Customer's SIM card is detected but locked (PIN/PUK required). Customer cannot access service or signal. Needs assistance unlocking SIM.
